author: Ochtendkast
body:
Hello,

I am banned from the server for 7 months already, i do understand why but, i want to start over and begin at a new begin. I want to be un-banned because i really love the server and i would like to play again on this server. I am banned for kill aura but i never hacked again since than because it feels bad to be banned and hacking sucks. I am Also a Human and humans make mistakes, pls forgive me for this mistake.

CryptioxPlayz.
